Solve some 80-90 of the 135 questions on your course VM and you’d be golden.

posts.name: Baskaran Nadar
posts.cooked:
While I am able to extract and synthesize the data from multiple files locally to construct the output file, the instructions on the portal leave several points unclear.

How will the portal evaluate or test my code?
Will all the ocr_xxxx.txt files be available to the code on the portal?
What command will be used to execute the code?

For example, will it be something like bash script.sh 5 to generate the output for card number 5?

Or are we expected to generate outputs for all available card numbers at once?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You can read the public test case input examples to understand. Those input are used to make your environment ready before your script is called.

Like this:

read offset
read ofile

if [[ $offset -ne 0 ]]; then
  cno=${ofile##*_}
  cno=${cno%.txt}
  cno=$((cno+offset))
  ofile="shopping_bill_$cno.txt"
fi

  while read file; do
    [[ $file == "EOF" ]] && break
    while read line; do
      [[ $line == "EOF" ]] && break
      echo $line
    done > $file
  done

script 

cat "$ofile"

Your script should generate all files, however only one file per test case will be evaluated (which is the 2nd line of input).

posts.cooked:
in my script, how do i extract, which card number the question is interested in and cat that file to the out put ?

I am creating all the bills ( 30 files) .

Is there any input from stdin ? or bash shell command like

bash script 5 ?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Please read the input and the code i sent above carefully, the answer already lies there.

Your script (script) does not know which file to output, it should always output all files, the evaluator code (which i shared above) selects which file to check for per test case, the how is explained in the code.

You need to:

  • assume all input files exist in current working directory
  • write the script correctly
  • output all files as expected (not just one of them)
